messages:
alex: Heads-up: PR #5719 (kv-cache batching) shows a small but consistent regression in tail latency on long-context canary. p95 up ~18% on 32k sequences. Need quick triage + approvals plan.

bench-bot: Canary run results attached. Summary: baseline p50 120ms p95 310ms p99 480ms; canary (pr-5719) p50 118ms p95 366ms p99 620ms. Throughput down ~6% at target QPS. Full logs: https://bench.artifacts/redwood/5719/canary

maria: Thanks — is this coming from the microbatching window change or the allocator/eviction tweak? PR description mentioned both.

alex: Main change is tightening the batching window and changing KV-cache eviction heuristics. I suspected eviction jitter; bench shows more tail though.

sam: Can you paste the raw grep of the latency lines? also which model config / seq len used for the canary?

bench-bot: ```
MODEL: redwood-13b
SEQ_LEN: 32768
QPS target: 40
BASELINE: p50:120ms p95:310ms p99:480ms
PR-5719: p50:118ms p95:366ms p99:620ms
GPU mem (baseline): 11.2GB
GPU mem (pr): 11.32GB (+120MB)
Throughput delta: -6.2%
```

taylor: If it's mainly tail, we can canary slowly and watch p99. We have a merge window at 17:00 UTC — do we want to hold until this is addressed?

jack: I skimmed the diff — there's a small racy path around the eviction timer. If we add a deterministic fallback and emit a metric, I can approve after that. Not comfortable merging as-is.

alex: Ok I can open a patch to add a fallback to deterministic eviction order and a metric flag guarded by an env var. ETA ~3h.

infra-bot: CI: all checks passed (unit/integration). Canary deploy scheduled at 16:30 UTC. Approvers: @taylor @jack.

maria: Can we also run a memory-pressure stress bench? If this is a mem spike under heavy concat it could explain p99 jumps and we should revert instead of patching.

taylor: Let's delay merge until alex's patch is LGTMed. If alex can't land by 16:30, revert the canary and roll back to baseline.

alex: Will push the patch and request review. If no approvals by 17:00 UTC, please hold merge and I'll open a revert PR.

jack: :thumbsup: I'll review after lunch. If I don't respond by 16:45 tag me again.

bench-bot: Follow-up run after alex's micropatch: p50:122ms p95:320ms p99:510ms. Improvement vs PR but still slightly above baseline p95. Artifact: https://bench.artifacts/redwood/5719/canary/followup

alex: Thanks — I marked PR-5719 as "awaiting jack" and attached the canary artifacts + the new metric. Ping me for emergency revert. /cc @sre-team
